title: Smart Route city profile
description: The geography of one deployment. Lives at <SMARTROUTE_DATA_DIR>/city_profile.json beside routes/ and csv/. Loaded and validated by smart-route-planning-agent/src/city_profile.py.

name.description: Display name of the city or region.

locations.description: Places a trip can start or end. Each mirrors the first or last <wpt> of the GPX routes that serve it.

desc.description: The GPX waypoint's <desc>. When present it is the location's label in trips, requests and dropdowns; otherwise name is.

default_trip.description: Trip planned until a commuter asks for another. Each end is a location's name or desc. Defaults to the first and last locations.

ignored_routes.description: GPX file names under routes/ the planner never offers.

route_labels.description: Human-readable route names keyed by GPX file name (the route id).

centre.description: Where maps open with no route to fit. Defaults to the mean of the locations.

intersections.description: Intersection publishers keyed by atSign role (as in config/ee_atsigns.json). Coordinates must be copied exactly from a <trkpt> of the route they should affect.

report_points.description: Extra known-good report locations (exact trackpoints) offered by the intersection app and CLI tools, ahead of the intersections.

attribution.description: Credit for the route and map data, e.g. the OpenStreetMap ODbL notice.
